g.data-note: Bree's hobbits dig their homes into the upper slope, above the houses of the Big Folk.
Tall timber houses face the Road; more windows glow as their folk come in out of the rain.
The big inn at the crossroads, where news and travellers from every road end up by the fire.
The gate in Bree's hedge where the Road comes in; it is shut at nightfall.
Unhitched by the hedge for the night, its load roped down under a sodden cover.
